description: This file declares functions related to the TorchScript lazy backend fallback mechanisms, including registration and execution fallback functions.

methods.name: force_eager_fallback
methods.description: Determines whether to force an eager fallback for a given operator symbol.

methods.name: ltc_eager_fallback
methods.description: Performs the eager fallback for lazy tensor computations.

methods.name: ts_eager_fallback
methods.description: Performs the TorchScript eager fallback for a given operator and device type.

methods.name: register_ts_ltc_eager_fallback
methods.description: Registers the TorchScript lazy tensor compile (LTC) eager fallback functionality.
